newsitem.title: UK: Buba's Jochimsen sees no need for further rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Jochimsen sees no need for further rate cut.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Reimut Jochimsen said on Tuesday he did not see a need for another cut in German interest rates but added "you never can tell. Never say never."

Asked by reporters in London if he saw scope for further rate cuts, Jochimsen noted that economic conditions were improving and both short and long term interest rates were historically low, adding "I don't see the need".
He said monetary policy had done its job and it was up to the government to help stimulate growth through measures such as tax and pension reforms.
Jochimsen criticised efforts by countries such as Italy and France to fulfill the debt criteria of the Maastricht Treaty through one-off fiscal measures.

"Even if these tricks are legal in terms of national accounting standards as defined by the European Commission...they will not be legitimate in the sense that they are violating the spirit of what you are trying to get at," he said.
